page_title: Most Realistic AI Voice Generator | WellSaid

summary.name: WellSaid
summary.one_liner: WellSaid is an AI text-to-speech voice generator whose voices are modeled on licensed recordings from real voice actors, offering 280+ voices across languages, accents, and styles.
use_cases: Making voiceovers for social media reels and TikToks
Adding consistent voiceovers to product marketing videos
Building text-to-speech into apps via API
summary.what_it_does: WellSaid generates AI voiceovers from text across 280+ voices, browsable by language, accent, tone, style, and use case. The page says each voice is modeled on licensed studio recordings from real voice actors. It supports 18 languages across regional variants, including several English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese variants. A team studio lets users organize projects into shared workspaces, comment, manage voice libraries, and set role-based access. The page also describes a developer text-to-speech API and Adobe Express and Premiere Pro integrations.
notable: Voices modeled on licensed recordings from real voice actors
Shared pronunciation library for product names and acronyms
Closed-model AI that keeps scripts and voice samples private (per page)
Full commercial usage rights on all audio, per page
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; a free trial is mentioned only in the meta description
Some 'Built for teams' content references enterprise-style tiers without listing prices
The page gives voice counts inconsistently (280+ in one place, 240+ in another)
